insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (Base Sum Insured + Booster+ + Safeguard/Safeguard+ + ReAssure+/ReAssureX as per Policy Schedule/variant)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: “We don’t limit your choice. Choose the room you like, but choose judiciously to protect your Sum Insured.”
great.explanation: You can select any room category without restrictions, so no daily room rent limits will reduce your claim. This gives you full freedom to choose your preferred hospital accommodation.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: “ReAssure ‘Forever’: Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured. The first paid claim in the life of the policy triggers ReAssure ‘Forever’. Once Triggered it stays for life, provided that the policy is renewed without break.”
great.explanation: After your first claim, unlimited additional Sum Insured is available for life if you renew continuously. This provides a strong financial safety net beyond your base Sum Insured.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: “Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured… (this 10 Lakh will trigger unlimited times)”
great.explanation: The policy allows unlimited reinstatements of Sum Insured after the first claim, enabling multiple claims even after exhausting the base limit. This means your coverage can renew repeatedly without extra premium.

great.name: PED Waiting Period
great.quote: “Pre-existing Diseases… shall be excluded until the expiry of 12months/24 months/ 36 months (as per Variant selected) of continuous coverage…”
great.explanation: You can select a variant with a 12-month waiting period for pre-existing diseases, which is shorter than usual. This means you can claim for pre-existing conditions sooner if you choose that variant.

great.name: Specific Illness Waiting
great.quote: “Specified disease/procedure waiting period… excluded until the expiry of 24 months/12 months (as per Variant Selected)…”
great.explanation: A 12-month waiting period option is available for specified illnesses or procedures, which is better than the standard 24 months. This lets you claim for these conditions earlier if you pick that variant.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: “30-day waiting period… Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident…”
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days except accidents, which is standard in the market. This means you cannot claim for new illnesses during the first month.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: “We will pay… for 60 days before the date of admission…”
good.reference: Section 4.1.3 Expenses before and after hospitalization
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days before hospital admission are covered if related to the hospitalization. This helps cover diagnostic and treatment costs leading to admission.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.reference: Section 4.1.3 Expenses before and after hospitalization
good.explanation: Expenses up to 180 days after discharge are covered if related to the hospitalization. This supports recovery costs after leaving the hospital.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: “Home Care / Domiciliary Treatment… treatment availed by the insured person at home… would require care and treatment at a hospital but is actually taken at home…”
good.explanation: Treatment taken at home that would otherwise require hospitalization is covered under domiciliary care. This provides flexibility for home-based medical care.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: “Air Ambulance: Only in case of Emergency. We will pay up to Base Sum Insured.”
good.reference: Section 4.1.1(a) Expenses in reaching a Hospital
good.explanation: Emergency air ambulance transport is covered up to the base Sum Insured, subject to hospitalization claim approval. This ensures quick transfer during critical emergencies.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: “Annexure I - The expenses that are not covered… List I – Expenses not covered… 56 GLOVES … 57 NEBULISATION KIT … 60 MASK …”
bad.reference: Annexure I (List I – Expenses not covered); Section 4.1.20.1.1 / 4.1.21.1 (only if Safeguard/Safeguard+ opted)
bad.explanation: Many common consumables like gloves and masks are excluded by default, meaning you pay out-of-pocket unless you opt for Safeguard/Safeguard+ cover. This can increase your expenses during hospitalization.

bad.name: No Claim Bonus
bad.quote: “Cumulative Bonus means any increase or addition in the Sum Insured granted by the insurer without an associated increase in premium.”
bad.reference: Definition 2.1.8 (definition only; no benefit clause found)
bad.explanation: Although defined, no actual No Claim Bonus benefit is stated, so your Sum Insured may not increase for claim-free years. This means you miss out on automatic coverage growth for staying healthy.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: “4.1.16. Co-Payment: It is the percentage of admissible claim amount You would have to bear for every claim, Rest we will pay.”
bad.reference: Section 4.1.16 Co-Payment (appears as an optional benefit, but default co-pay for base plan not specified here)
bad.explanation: The policy mentions co-payment but does not clearly state the default co-pay percentage for base hospitalization claims. You should check your Policy Schedule to know if any co-pay applies.

unclear.name: PED Waiting Period
unclear.quote: “...excluded until the expiry of 12months/24 months/ 36 months (as per Variant selected)…”
unclear.explanation: The waiting period for pre-existing diseases depends on the variant you select. Confirm your exact waiting period in the Policy Schedule.

unclear.name: Specific Illness Waiting
unclear.quote: “...excluded until the expiry of 24 months/12 months (as per Variant Selected)…”
unclear.explanation: The waiting period for specified illnesses varies by variant. Check your Policy Schedule to know the applicable duration.

unclear.name: Restore Benefit
unclear.quote: “Either ReAssure+ or ReAssureX can be offered in a single policy.”
unclear.explanation: The policy may offer one of two restore benefits depending on configuration. Verify which restore feature applies to your policy in the Policy Schedule.

unclear.name: Modern Treatments
unclear.quote: “We pay for Modern treatments, up to Base Sum Insured for the list as specified below…”
unclear.explanation: Coverage for modern treatments is up to the base Sum Insured, but the policy does not clarify if sub-limits apply per procedure. Check your Policy Schedule or annexures for details.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
